figures.caption: Figure 1: BrainDyn encodes each region’s temporal history with an LSTM, and then uses learnable sheaf restriction maps to align and modulate interactions across brain regions. The resulting spatially encoded latent state is evolved with a neural ODE to predict future brain dynamics.

Table 1: Prediction of resting-state fMRI dynamics on the PNC dataset and EEG dynamics on the TUSZ dataset. Metrics reported as mean ± std across 5-fold cross-validation. Lower is better. Best results are bolded.

Table 2: Neural dynamics forecasting on synthetic NEST dataset of perturbed, out-of-distribution brain dynamics. Metrics reported as mean ± standard deviation across 5-fold cross-validation. Lower is better. Best results are bolded.
